question: Brazil unemployment below 6.3% for Q4 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Brazil's unemployment rate for Q4 2025 is below 6.3% when it is released. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve according to IBGE's (https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/indicators#desemprego) public release of the Q4 2025 figure unemployment, expected in January 2026. If the publication of this figure is delayed beyond February 28, 2026 ET, this market will resolve according to the last published figure. 

Because this market's resolution source reports quarterly unemployment to one decimal point (e.g. 4.5%), this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

subquestions.question: Will Brazil's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate in the PNAD Contínua release covering the quarter ending in August 2025 be reported by IBGE as 5.5% or lower by 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
Brazil's labor market has tightened sharply in 2025, making near-term IBGE releases highly informative for whether Q4 2025 unemployment will end up below 6.3%. IBGE reported a record-low 5.8% unemployment rate for the quarter ending in June 2025, with employed persons at 102.3 million and average real income at a record level (Agência Brasil summarizing IBGE: https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/en/economia/noticia/2025-08/brazils-unemployment-falls-58-lowest-record). In mid-September, multiple reports citing the latest IBGE PNAD Contínua release said the unemployment rate for the quarter ending in July 2025 had fallen further to about 5.6%, again near or at a record low (Agência Brasil summary: https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/en/economia/noticia/2025-09/unemployment-falls-56-lowest-2012-shows-ibge; Exame discussion of IBGE data and economist expectations: https://exame.com/economia/brasil-atinge-pleno-emprego-com-baixa-informalidade-e-renda-recorde-do-trabalhador/). Exame also reported an economist projection that unemployment could fall to 5.5% in the quarter ending in August 2025, which is directly relevant because a realized figure at or below 5.5% would indicate the labor market entered Q4 from an exceptionally tight position. Since the ultimate question asks whether Q4 2025 unemployment will be below 6.3%, the next official PNAD Contínua print for the quarter ending in August is a strong leading indicator: if unemployment is already 5.5% or lower before Q4 is even complete, it becomes easier for the later Q4 reading to remain below 6.3% absent a sharp deterioration.

The resolution source should be IBGE's official PNAD Contínua monthly/quarterly unemployment publication page, which publishes the unemployment rate and typically includes both seasonally adjusted and unadjusted series for rolling quarters: https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/statistics/social/labor/16809-quarterly-dissemination-pnad2.html and the indicators portal at https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/indicators#desemprego. The August-ending quarter release is expected during October 2025, so it fits the required subquestion window.

Sources:
Agência Brasil - Brazil's unemployment falls to 5.8%, lowest on record - https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/en/economia/noticia/2025-08/brazils-unemployment-falls-58-lowest-record
Agência Brasil - Unemployment falls to 5.6%, lowest since 2012, shows IBGE - https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/en/economia/noticia/2025-09/unemployment-falls-56-lowest-2012-shows-ibge
Exame - Brasil atinge 'pleno emprego' com baixa informalidade e renda recorde do trabalhador - https://exame.com/economia/brasil-atinge-pleno-emprego-com-baixa-informalidade-e-renda-recorde-do-trabalhador/
IBGE PNAD Contínua page - https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/statistics/social/labor/16809-quarterly-dissemination-pnad2.html
IBGE Indicators portal - https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/indicators#desemprego
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, IBGE publicly releases a PNAD Contínua unemployment update for the rolling quarter ending in August 2025 and that release reports Brazil's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate as 5.5% or lower.

This question resolves No if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, IBGE publicly releases that rolling-quarter-ending-August-2025 figure and the reported seasonally adjusted unemployment rate is above 5.5%.

Primary source: IBGE official unemployment indicators/publications, especially the PNAD Contínua page and/or IBGE indicators portal:
- https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/statistics/social/labor/16809-quarterly-dissemination-pnad2.html
- https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/indicators#desemprego

If IBGE publishes the value in Portuguese but not English first, the Portuguese IBGE publication counts, provided it is on an official IBGE domain and clearly identifies the rolling quarter ending in August 2025 ("trimestre móvel encerrado em agosto de 2025") and the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate ("taxa de desocupação dessazonalizada").

If multiple IBGE tables/releases on the same publication date contain the figure, the seasonally adjusted national unemployment rate for Brazil in the main PNAD Contínua release or associated official tables controls. Resolution should use the percentage as published by IBGE to one decimal place.

If no qualifying IBGE release for the rolling quarter ending in August 2025 is published by 2025-10-31, this question should be considered unresolvable rather than inferred from media reports or unofficial calendars.
subquestions.rationale: The next official unemployment print is the most direct near-term signal of whether Brazil's labor market remains tight enough for Q4 2025 unemployment to finish below 6.3%. A reading of 5.5% or lower by late October would indicate sustained labor-market strength heading into Q4 and materially support a Yes outcome on the ultimate question.

evidence.step1_decompose: Condition for Yes: IBGE must publicly release PNAD Contínua quarterly unemployment for rolling quarter ending August 2025 between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31, AND the seasonally adjusted rate must be ≤5.5%. Observable evidence: IBGE official publication on ibge.gov.br with explicit reference to 'trimestre móvel encerrado em agosto de 2025' and a seasonally adjusted unemployment rate of 5.5% or lower. Key entities: IBGE, PNAD Contínua, Brazil, seasonally adjusted unemployment, August 2025 quarter, October 2025 window.
evidence.step2_search_queries: Searches conducted: (1) 'IBGE PNAD Contínua unemployment rate August 2025 Brazil' Oct 2025 window; (2) 'Brazil unemployment rate PNAD October 2025 IBGE' Oct 2025 window; (3) 'taxa desocupação dessazonalizada PNAD Contínua trimestre agosto 2025' Oct 2025; (4) 'Brazil unemployment rate 6% 6.5% 7% PNAD quarterly October 2025'; (5) 'IBGE desemprego Brasil agosto 2025 PNAD trimestral outubro'; (6) 'Brazil unemployment falls record low 2025 IBGE labor market'; (7) 'PNAD Contínua trimestral desocupação outubro 2025 IBGE divulgação'; (8) 'Brazil jobless rate quarterly PNAD August quarter 2025 seasonally adjusted'; (9) 'IBGE unemployment Brazil October 2025 quarterly release'; (10) 'desemprego IBGE agosto 2025 desocupação'; (11) 'Brazil unemployment rate low 2025 IBGE record quarter'.
evidence.step3_event_detection: No candidate events found matching the resolution criteria. Articles found covered: CAGED formal job creation data (October 30, 2025), app-based worker PNAD data (October 17, 2025), industrial production data, retail sales, IBC-Br economic activity, and various non-Brazil unemployment releases. None referenced the PNAD Contínua quarterly unemployment data for the rolling quarter ending August 2025.
evidence.step4_criteria_matching: No articles explicitly matched the criteria. The PNAD Contínua quarterly unemployment release for the rolling quarter ending August 2025 was not found in any search results. No seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for Brazil for this specific quarter was reported in the evidence gathered.
evidence.step5_timestamp_extraction: No timestamp could be extracted as no qualifying event was found in the search results.
evidence.step7_verification: No contradictory evidence found, but more importantly, no confirming evidence found either. The searches covered the full October 2025 window and various phrasings in English and Portuguese. The absence of results from news sources about this specific IBGE release during the window is notable. Brazil's non-seasonally adjusted unemployment rate has been in the 6-7% range in recent quarters, making a seasonally adjusted rate of 5.5% or below potentially plausible given seasonal adjustment factors, but this cannot be confirmed without the actual IBGE publication.
evidence.step8_final_decision: The question cannot be resolved because there is no explicit, verifiable evidence that IBGE published the PNAD Contínua quarterly unemployment rate for the rolling quarter ending August 2025 during the October 2025 window, nor any evidence of the specific value. Without both the confirmation of publication and the specific reported value, neither a Yes nor No determination can be made with certainty.

question: Will Trump pardon Sam Bankman-Fried in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed individual receives a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve from Donald Trump by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for whether the individual is pardoned or not will be official information from the US government, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Sam Bankman-Fried or his legal team file any new clemency-related petition, application, or public request directed to the President of the United States or the Office of the Pardon Attorney between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term indicator for whether Donald Trump might pardon Sam Bankman-Fried in 2025 is whether there is visible movement toward clemency during October 2025. Reporting before 2025-10-01 indicates that Bankman-Fried and his parents have been seeking a pardon and consulting people connected to Trump's orbit. Decrypt reported in May 2025 that Sam Bankman-Fried was "reportedly campaigning for a pardon," with his parents and lawyers consulting with people close to Trump's inner circles: https://decrypt.co/319130/which-crypto-founders-are-seeking-pardons-from-president-trump . Coinspeaker similarly reported in May 2025 that Bankman-Fried's parents were seeking a presidential pardon and discussing options with legal experts and entities linked to Trump's administration: https://www.coinspeaker.com/sam-bankman-fried-release-earlier/ .

There is also a plausible political pathway for crypto-related clemency. Forbes reported in May 2025 that Trump had already been making significant use of pardons and commutations and that observers expected more such actions, including possible crypto-related ones: https://www.forbes.com/sites/alisondurkee/2025/05/28/trump-makes-news-with-more-pardons-and-commutations/ . Decrypt reported that Binance founder Changpeng Zhao had confirmed he was applying for a pardon, suggesting pardon-seeking by crypto figures was an active current phenomenon rather than a hypothetical one: https://decrypt.co/319130/which-crypto-founders-are-seeking-pardons-from-president-trump .

Meanwhile, Sam Bankman-Fried's direct criminal case remains active. Cointelegraph reported on 2025-09-11 that the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit scheduled oral arguments in his appeal for November 4, 2025, and noted his Bureau of Prisons projected release date as October 25, 2044: https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-court-hear-arguments-sam-bankman-fried-appeal-nov-4 . The existence of an upcoming appeal makes clemency activity especially informative: a fresh filing or public request in October 2025 would be concrete evidence that Bankman-Fried's camp is actively pursuing executive relief before year-end, which should increase the perceived odds of a Trump pardon by December 31, 2025.

Sources:
Decrypt - Which Crypto Founders Are Seeking Pardons From President Trump? https://decrypt.co/319130/which-crypto-founders-are-seeking-pardons-from-president-trump
Coinspeaker - FTX Founder Sam Bankman-Fried To Leave Jail Earlier https://www.coinspeaker.com/sam-bankman-fried-release-earlier/
Forbes - Trump Makes News With More Pardons And Commutations https://www.forbes.com/sites/alisondurkee/2025/05/28/trump-makes-news-with-more-pardons-and-commutations/
Cointelegraph - US court to hear arguments for Sam Bankman-Fried's appeal on Nov. 4 https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-court-hear-arguments-sam-bankman-fried-appeal-nov-4
U.S. Department of Justice - Office of the Pardon Attorney https://www.justice.gov/pardon
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, there is credible public evidence that Sam Bankman-Fried, his attorneys, or an authorized representative acting on his behalf filed, submitted, or publicly announced a new clemency-related petition, application, request, or letter seeking a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve from President Donald Trump.

Qualifying evidence includes any of the following during the window 2025-10-01 through 2025-10-31: (a) an official court filing, Department of Justice filing, or Office of the Pardon Attorney record; (b) a public statement by Sam Bankman-Fried's lawyer or authorized spokesperson explicitly saying a clemency request was submitted during the window; or (c) at least two independent, credible news reports stating that a new clemency request or application was filed or submitted during the window.

This question does NOT resolve Yes merely because an older request, made before 2025-10-01, is reported on again in October. It requires a new filing, submission, or public request first made between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive. Mere commentary, speculation, advocacy by unrelated third parties, or reports that he 'wants a pardon' without evidence of a new submission do not qualify.

Primary resolution sources: U.S. Department of Justice Office of the Pardon Attorney https://www.justice.gov/pardon ; official court dockets if relevant (PACER or publicly accessible docket reports); official statements from counsel; and reporting from major outlets such as Reuters https://www.reuters.com/ , AP https://apnews.com/ , or other high-credibility financial/legal media. If official sources are unavailable or incomplete, a consensus of at least two independent credible reports may be used.

If no qualifying new clemency-related filing, submission, or public request is evidenced between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, this question resolves No. If purported evidence emerges but cannot establish whether the relevant action occurred within the stated window, the question should resolve as Unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A pardon usually becomes more likely when the target or their allies actively pursue clemency. A new October filing or public request would be a concrete, near-term signal of active lobbying and procedural movement toward executive clemency, making it a useful early indicator for the ultimate question without merely restating it.

evidence.step1_decompose: Condition for Yes: SBF, his attorneys, or authorized representative must have filed, submitted, or publicly announced a NEW clemency-related petition/application/request between Oct 1–31, 2025, directed to President Trump or the Office of the Pardon Attorney. Observable evidence: (a) official DOJ/OPA record, (b) statement from SBF's lawyer confirming new October 2025 submission, or (c) at least two independent credible reports of a new filing specifically in the October window. Key distinction: reports of ongoing lobbying/advocacy or re-reports of pre-October activity do not qualify.
evidence.step2_search_queries: Query 1: 'Sam Bankman-Fried clemency pardon application October 2025' (to find any official filings); Query 2: 'SBF pardon commutation petition Trump 2025' (to find formal submissions); Query 3: 'Sam Bankman-Fried official clemency petition filing Office Pardon Attorney October 2025' (targeting official filings specifically); Query 4: 'SBF legal team lawyer filed pardon application formal submission 2025' (to find attorney confirmation of formal submission).
evidence.step3_event_detection: Candidate events identified: (1) SBF's GETTR/social media posts claiming political bias and seeking clemency - but these are public social media posts, not formal petitions to OPA or President, and timing within October 2025 window is not explicitly established; (2) Parents' lobbying efforts - described as January 2025, pre-window; (3) Tucker Carlson podcast appearance - media campaign, not formal filing; (4) Laura Loomer's claims of 'massive lobbying effort' - third-party speculation without documented formal filing; (5) Prediction market odds rising after CZ pardon - market speculation, not evidence of filing. All rejected as not constituting formal clemency petitions within the window.
evidence.step4_criteria_matching: Decrypt (Oct 14): explicitly states 'no firms are registered under the Lobbying Disclosure Act for a Bankman-Fried pardon; the Justice Department's 2025 clemency list does not include him; and no official petition or White House statement confirms progress beyond exploratory discussions.' [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/344233/laura-loomer-stokes-speculation-trump-sbf-pardon). CCN (Oct 15): 'no official indication exists that the Trump administration is considering a pardon: the Department of Justice and White House have not commented, no clemency filings are in the public record.' [CCN](https://www.ccn.com/news/crypto/sam-bankman-fried-pardon-warnings-coordinated-lobbying-effort/). CoinCentral (Oct 15) references 'a clemency request to Donald Trump' but in context of GETTR social media posts, not a formal OPA filing. No article explicitly reports a new, formal clemency petition filed with OPA or the President in October 2025.
evidence.step5_timestamp_extraction: No exact timestamp for a qualifying formal clemency filing exists in the evidence. Multiple articles explicitly note the absence of official filings as of mid-October 2025.
evidence.step6_first_occurrence_check: Not applicable — no qualifying formal filing was identified in the October 2025 window.
evidence.step7_verification: Contradictory check: Multiple credible outlets (Decrypt, CCN) explicitly confirm NO official clemency filings are in the public record as of October 2025. The Cointelegraph article (Oct 29) about Trump's crypto pardons mentions SBF 'sought pardons' but does not describe any new formal petition filed in October. All evidence describes informal lobbying, media campaigns, and social media posts — not formal OPA or presidential petition filings. The resolution criteria explicitly excludes 'mere commentary, speculation, advocacy by unrelated third parties, or reports that he wants a pardon without evidence of a new submission.'
evidence.step8_final_decision: No qualifying new clemency-related filing, submission, or formal public request directed to the President or Office of the Pardon Attorney was evidenced between October 1–31, 2025. Multiple credible sources explicitly confirm the absence of official filings. What was reported during this window — social media posts, media campaigns, parents' lobbying, third-party speculation — does not meet the resolution criteria. The question resolves No, with the window closing at October 31, 2025.

question: Will Claude 5 be released by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Anthropic's Claude 5 model is made available to the general public by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

For this market to resolve to "Yes," Claude 5 must be launched and publicly accessible, including via open beta or open rolling waitlist signups. A closed beta or any form of private access will not suffice. The release must be clearly defined and publicly announced by Anthropic as being accessible to the general public.

Claude 5 refers to a product explicitly named Claude 5 (e.g. Claude 5.0 would count), or one that is recognized as a successor to Claude 4, similar to the progression from Claude 2 to Claude 3. Products labeled as Claude 4.5 or similar will not count for this market's resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Anthropic, with additional verification from a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Anthropic publicly announce a new flagship Claude model family after Claude Sonnet 4.5—specifically any model explicitly named "Claude 5", "Claude Opus 5", or "Claude Sonnet 5"—between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive)?
subquestions.background_information:
Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.5 on 2025-09-29, just before this subquestion's start date, and described it as its latest major coding-focused model. Multiple reports say Sonnet 4.5 is available broadly via the Claude API and Claude apps, indicating Anthropic is still actively shipping major Claude updates on a rapid cadence. TechCrunch reports that Sonnet 4.5 launched less than two months after Claude Opus 4.1, highlighting an unusually fast release cycle that could make another major model-family announcement by year-end plausible. See: https://techcrunch.com/2025/09/29/anthropic-launches-claude-sonnet-4-5-its-best-ai-model-for-coding/ .

Reporting around the release describes Sonnet 4.5 as a substantial but non-generational update, with the ultimate market explicitly stating that "Claude 4.5"-style naming would not count as Claude 5. That makes a public naming shift to a new flagship family a meaningful indicator for whether Anthropic is on track to release Claude 5 by December 31, 2025. If Anthropic publicly announces a model explicitly branded as Claude 5, Claude Opus 5, or Claude Sonnet 5 during October, that would strongly suggest the company is accelerating toward a public Claude 5 launch before year-end.

Current evidence of Anthropic's release tempo includes: Sonnet 4.5 availability via Claude API and chatbot, unchanged pricing versus Sonnet 4, and integration into Claude Code and related developer tooling, as reported by TechCrunch and Anthropic-linked coverage. See https://techcrunch.com/2025/09/29/anthropic-launches-claude-sonnet-4-5-its-best-ai-model-for-coding/ and https://www.anthropic.com/ .

Because the ultimate question hinges on a publicly accessible Claude 5 release by 2025-12-31, an earlier public announcement of a new flagship Claude-5-branded family is a useful leading indicator distinct from the ultimate question itself. It does not require public availability, only a public announcement of the new model family.

Sources:
Anthropic website — https://www.anthropic.com/
TechCrunch: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 4.5, its best AI model for coding — https://techcrunch.com/2025/09/29/anthropic-launches-claude-sonnet-4-5-its-best-ai-model-for-coding/
Analytics India Magazine: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 4.5 — https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news-updates/anthropic-launches-claude-sonnet-4-5-touts-it-as-best-coding-model-in-the-world/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Anthropic publicly announces, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), any new Claude model explicitly named "Claude 5", "Claude Opus 5", or "Claude Sonnet 5" in an official public-facing source.

Qualifying official public-facing sources include: Anthropic's website or blog (https://www.anthropic.com/), Anthropic documentation pages (https://docs.anthropic.com/), Anthropic's official X/Twitter account or other verified official social channels, or an official press release distributed by Anthropic.

The announcement need not make the model generally available to the public. It is sufficient that Anthropic publicly presents the model as an announced product or model name. Mentions in leaks, rumors, third-party reporting, code strings, benchmark listings, app teardowns, or partner materials without a matching official Anthropic public announcement do not count.

This question resolves No if no such official Anthropic public announcement occurs between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive).

If Anthropic announces only a model branded as "Claude 4.5", "Claude 4.6", or similar non-5 naming during the window, that does not count. question: Will Russia capture Huliaipole by December 31?

subquestions.question: Will DeepStateMap show any Russian-controlled area inside Varvarivka, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, by 2025-12-23?
subquestions.background_information:
Varvarivka is a village on the northern approach to Huliaipole and is repeatedly cited by analysts as a likely next waypoint if Russian forces continue exploiting recent gains north of the city. Ukrainians and OSINT analysts reported worsening Russian pressure in eastern Zaporizhzhia in early-to-mid November 2025. DeepState, as summarized by Ukrainska Pravda on 2025-11-10, said the gray zone had expanded around Solodke, Novomykolaivka, Rivnopillia, Nove, and Novouspenivske, and that the occupation of Rivnopillia created a corridor from the north that complicated Huliaipole’s defense. https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/10/7509475/ On 2025-11-12, Ukrainska Pravda further reported that after occupying Rivnopillia, Russian forces had gained room to advance toward Huliaipole and might continue toward Varvarivka while intensifying strikes to disrupt Ukrainian logistics. https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/12/7509808/ The Kyiv Independent, citing Black Bird Group on 2025-11-22, reported that Russian forces had likely captured over 15 villages in Zaporizhzhia Oblast since September and could try to flank Huliaipole from the north, potentially putting it under encirclement threat. https://kyivindependent.com/russia-likely-captured-over-15-villages-in-zaporizhzhia-oblast-since-september-osint-group-says/ Because the ultimate question is about capturing a specific intersection in Huliaipole by late December, a nearer-term indicator is whether Russian control reaches Varvarivka at all. Control entering Varvarivka would suggest Russia has converted recent northern advances into direct pressure on Huliaipole’s immediate outer approach, materially increasing the odds of the ultimate outcome.

Ukrainska Pravda - Russians Gain Room to Advance on Huliaipole After Occupying Rivnopillia - https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/12/7509808/
Ukrainska Pravda - DeepState Reports Worsening Situation in Zaporizhzhia Oblast - https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/11/10/7509475/

DeepStateMap - https://deepstatemap.live/

subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-23 and 2025-12-23 inclusive, DeepStateMap shows any portion of the built-up area of Varvarivka, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, as Russian-controlled (typically red on the map). For purposes of resolution, 'inside Varvarivka' means within the village area labeled 'Varvarivka' on DeepStateMap or, if labeling is unclear, within the village footprint identifiable on standard basemaps underlying DeepStateMap. If DeepStateMap is unavailable or ceases updating, the fallback source will be the ISW Ukraine map at https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375. Under that fallback, the question resolves Yes if ISW shows any part of Varvarivka as Russian-occupied/captured during the same window, 2025-11-23 through 2025-12-23 inclusive.

If both maps become permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible OSINT/cartographic reporting may be used, prioritizing organizations that regularly publish front-line control maps. Temporary glitches, brief rendering errors, or uncorroborated Russian government claims alone will not qualify. If no qualifying map evidence appears by 2025-12-23, the question resolves No. If the status cannot be determined from the stated sources because of prolonged data failure with no credible fallback consensus, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A Russian entry into Varvarivka would be a concrete operational milestone on Huliaipole’s northern approach rather than a mere earlier-deadline restatement of the city-capture question. It tracks whether recent gains around Rivnopillia are translating into immediate pressure on Huliaipole’s outskirts, which should significantly update forecasts on whether Russia can reach the specified intersection by late December.

evidence.step1_decompose: Required: DeepStateMap must explicitly show Varvarivka, Zaporizhzhia Oblast as Russian-controlled (red) between 2025-11-23 and 2025-12-23 inclusive. Observable evidence: DeepStateMap update marking Varvarivka as red, or credible OSINT confirming same. Key entity: village of Varvarivka ~9km NW of Huliaipole, Zaporizhzhia Oblast.
evidence.step2_search_queries: 1) 'Varvarivka Zaporizhzhia Russian control 2025' - found Russian claim of capture Dec 14; 2) 'Varvarivka captured DeepState map December 2025' - found DeepState reports on Huliaipole but not Varvarivka explicitly; 3) 'Varvarivka Huliaipole frontline Russian advance December 14 2025' - found Ukraine denial and Ukrainian GS reports showing attacks 'toward' Varvarivka; 4) 'DeepState Huliaipole advance December 15 16 2025' - found DeepState confirmed advance IN Huliaipole but no explicit Varvarivka red designation; 5) 'Varvarivka Ukraine denied captured OSINT December 2025' - confirmed Ukraine denial; 6) 'DeepState Varvarivka Zaporizhzhia December 19 2025' - found reference to DeepState reporting Zaporizhzhia advances Dec 19 but no specific Varvarivka confirmation.
evidence.step3_event_detection: Candidate event 1: Russian MoD claim of Varvarivka capture on Dec 14, 2025 - REJECTED per resolution criteria (Russian government claims alone do not qualify). Candidate event 2: DeepState report of Russian advances in Huliaipole (Dec 15) - does not mention Varvarivka specifically. Candidate event 3: Ukraine General Staff reports Dec 14-18 showing attacks 'toward Varvarivka' - this language suggests Varvarivka was NOT yet captured per Ukrainian assessment. Candidate event 4: DeepState Dec 19 advance in Zaporizhzhia Oblast - referenced but not specific to Varvarivka.
evidence.step4_criteria_matching: Russia's Dec 14 claim of Varvarivka capture [Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-claims-it-took-control-of-another-settlement-in-ukraine-s-zaporizhzhia-region/3770963) does not satisfy criteria as 'uncorroborated Russian government claims alone will not qualify.' Ukraine denied the claim. Ukrainian GS reports Dec 14-18 consistently describe attacks 'toward Varvarivka' not 'in Varvarivka.' DeepState Dec 15 report [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/12/16/8012007/) confirmed advances in Huliaipole but specifically NOT Varvarivka. No explicit DeepStateMap red-zone designation for Varvarivka found in available sources.
evidence.step5_timestamp_extraction: No reliable timestamp found for DeepStateMap explicitly marking Varvarivka as Russian-controlled (red). The only explicit capture claim is from Russia on Dec 14 (denied by Ukraine and unverified by independent OSINT).
evidence.step6_first_occurrence_check: No qualifying first occurrence found. The DeepState reports available do not confirm Varvarivka as Russian-controlled. Fighting was ongoing 'toward/near' Varvarivka through Dec 18 per Ukrainian GS reports.
evidence.step7_verification: Ukrainian General Staff reports from Dec 14, 15, 16, and 18 all describe combat 'toward Varvarivka' — not 'in' or 'at' Varvarivka — which is consistent with the village not yet being under Russian control per Ukrainian/DeepState assessment. DeepState's Dec 15 report specifically listed Huliaipole, Predtechyne, Shakhove, and Stepnohirsk but omitted Varvarivka. Ukraine denied the Russian capture claim. Context: Russia also falsely claimed capture of Malaya Tokmachka (an error exposed by CIT/Kirill Mikhailov), and other inflated claims in this period, further reducing credibility of Russian-only claims.
evidence.step8_final_decision: The resolution criteria require DeepStateMap (or ISW as fallback) to show Varvarivka as Russian-controlled (red), not merely contested. Russia claimed capture on Dec 14 but Ukraine denied it and independent verification was unavailable. Ukrainian General Staff reports through Dec 18 referred to attacks 'toward Varvarivka,' implying it was still contested/Ukrainian. DeepState's own reporting around Dec 15-16 confirmed advances in Huliaipole but not Varvarivka specifically. No source explicitly confirms DeepStateMap showed Varvarivka as red (Russian-controlled) within the resolution window. Therefore, resolves No.

question: Will Azerbaijan join the Abraham Accords in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed country formally signs a normalization agreement with Israel under the framework of the Abraham Accords by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A formal signing refers to an official agreement between Israel and another country that is publicly acknowledged by both governments and clearly attributed to the Abraham Accords or their continuation.

The resolution source will be official government statements, however a consensus for credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the White House, U.S. Department of State, or Azerbaijan's presidency/foreign ministry publicly state between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 that Azerbaijan is in negotiations or formal talks to join the Abraham Accords?
subquestions.background_information:
Azerbaijan already has substantial but informal ties with Israel, making official confirmation of accession talks a meaningful near-term indicator for whether it could join the Abraham Accords by the end of 2025. Israel and Azerbaijan maintain close energy, defense, and diplomatic relations; for example, Azerbaijan's embassy in Tel Aviv opened in 2023, and Israel's foreign ministry described bilateral ties as strategic: https://www.gov.il/en/departments/news/azerbaijan-embassy-inauguration-29-mar-2023 . Reuters-reported summaries in September 2025 said the Trump administration was discussing adding Azerbaijan to the Abraham Accords, indicating that the possibility is live rather than hypothetical: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/What-are-the-Abraham-Accords-47877244/ and https://www.yahoo.com/news/factbox-what-abraham-accords-145104122.html . Reporting in August 2025 also said U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff referenced negotiations over multiple countries joining the Accords, with contemporaneous reporting linking Azerbaijan to those efforts: https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/415220 . Separately, the U.S.-brokered Armenia-Azerbaijan agreement signed in August 2025 was described by several outlets as a diplomatic opening that could facilitate Azerbaijan's eventual Abraham Accords entry: https://www.business-standard.com/world-news/world-leaders-hail-armenia-azerbaijan-peace-deal-urge-cautious-optimism-125081000072_1.html and https://amwalalghad.com/armenia-azerbaijan-to-sign-us-brokered-peace-deal-granting-us-exclusive-corridor-rights/ . Because formal accession by 2025 would likely require at least some public acknowledgment of negotiations beforehand, such a statement in October would be a strong leading indicator.

Sources:
Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Azerbaijan embassy inauguration: https://www.gov.il/en/departments/news/azerbaijan-embassy-inauguration-29-mar-2023
MarketScreener / Reuters factbox on Abraham Accords: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/What-are-the-Abraham-Accords-47877244/
Yahoo / Reuters factbox on Abraham Accords: https://www.yahoo.com/news/factbox-what-abraham-accords-145104122.html
Arutz Sheva on Witkoff comments: https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/415220
Business Standard on Armenia-Azerbaijan agreement: https://www.business-standard.com/world-news/world-leaders-hail-armenia-azerbaijan-peace-deal-urge-cautious-optimism-125081000072_1.html
Amwal Al Ghad on U.S.-brokered framework and Abraham Accords angle: https://amwalalghad.com/armenia-azerbaijan-to-sign-us-brokered-peace-deal-granting-us-exclusive-corridor-rights/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, at least one of the following publishes or delivers a public statement explicitly saying that Azerbaijan is in negotiations, talks, discussions, or a formal process to join the Abraham Accords: (a) the White House, including whitehouse.gov or an official press briefing/transcript page; (b) the U.S. Department of State, including state.gov; (c) the Office of the President of Azerbaijan, including president.az; or (d) the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Azerbaijan, including mfa.gov.az.

The statement must explicitly connect Azerbaijan to possible accession to the Abraham Accords (or entry into / joining / becoming part of the Abraham Accords). General praise for peace with Israel, or generic statements about regional cooperation, do not count. Statements that merely say the U.S. hopes more countries will join, without naming Azerbaijan, do not count.

This question also resolves Yes if the same claim is made in an official on-camera briefing or transcript hosted on an official government website listed above, even if not in a standalone press release.

It resolves No if no qualifying official public statement appears between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive.

Primary sources for resolution:
- White House: https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/
- U.S. Department of State: https://www.state.gov/news/
- President of Azerbaijan: https://president.az/en
- Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Azerbaijan: https://mfa.gov.az/en

Fallback source: if a qualifying statement is made live during the window but the official transcript is delayed beyond 2025-10-31, credible contemporaneous reporting from Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/) or AP News (https://apnews.com/) quoting the statement verbatim from the official speaker may be used, provided the report clearly indicates the statement occurred within the 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-31 window. If source material is contradictory or the statement date cannot be established within the window, the question resolves based on the official-source record only.
subquestions.rationale: A public official acknowledgment that Azerbaijan is actively discussing Abraham Accords entry would be a major process signal short of actual accession. It is meaningfully different from the ultimate question because it tracks negotiations rather than a final signing, yet it should substantially update expectations about whether a formal agreement can be completed by year-end.

evidence.step1_decompose: The question requires that between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31, at least one of four specific official sources — (a) White House, (b) U.S. State Department, (c) Office of the President of Azerbaijan, or (d) Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Azerbaijan — publishes or delivers a public statement EXPLICITLY stating that Azerbaijan is in negotiations, talks, discussions, or a formal process to JOIN the Abraham Accords. Generic regional cooperation statements, general calls for more countries to join (without naming Azerbaijan), or praise for Israel-Azerbaijan ties do not count.
evidence.step2_search_queries: 1) 'Azerbaijan Abraham Accords negotiations talks 2025' (Oct 1-31) — to find direct evidence of explicit official statements. 2) 'White House State Department Azerbaijan Abraham Accords join' (Oct 1-31) — to find U.S. official statements naming Azerbaijan. 3) 'Azerbaijan Abraham Accords official statement White House State Department October 2025' — targeted at qualifying institutions. 4) 'Azerbaijan join Abraham Accords Israel normalization 2025' (Sep-Oct 2025) — broader window including lead-up. 5) 'Rubio State Department Azerbaijan Abraham Accords specifically named October 2025' — focused on State Department. 6) 'Azerbaijan Ministry Foreign Affairs Israel Abraham Accords normalization statement' (Oct) — focused on Azerbaijani side. 7) 'Aliyev Abraham Accords Israel normalization talks October 2025' — for Azerbaijani president. 8) 'Azerbaijan Israel normalization formal talks accession agreement 2025' — for formal talks.
evidence.step3_event_detection: Candidate events identified and evaluated: (A) White House article (Oct 10) about Azerbaijan-Armenia peace deal at White House — does NOT mention Azerbaijan joining Abraham Accords; the article is about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace accord. (B) Trump statements (Oct 15-17) at Egypt summit and Fox Business interview — urges more countries to join Abraham Accords generally, mentions Saudi Arabia by name, but does NOT name Azerbaijan. (C) Rubio statements (Oct 24) — 'We have a lot of countries that want to join' — does NOT name Azerbaijan. (D) WND/Daily Signal article (Oct 15) — identifies Azerbaijan as a 'top candidate' but this is from Heritage Foundation/think-tank experts, NOT from the four official sources. (E) Arutz Sheva article (Oct 17) — 'Reports from months prior suggested active U.S. talks with Azerbaijan' — this refers to reports from prior to October, not an official statement during the window. (F) Azerbaijani MFA statements (Oct 10) — welcome Gaza ceasefire, no mention of Abraham Accords for Azerbaijan. (G) Azertag NAM article (Oct 16) — Azerbaijan MFA at NAM meeting, mentions Abraham Accords only in context of Middle East peace support and Palestine. (H) Fox News article (Oct 26) mentioning Azerbaijan interested in stabilization force in Gaza — not related to Abraham Accords. (I) Rabbis summit in Baku articles (from September) — Iranian/Mehr News Agency framing Azerbaijan-Israel ties in Abraham Accords context, but not official statements. (J) 'Azerbaijan-Kazakhstan-Israel triangle' article (Oct 27) — commentary/analysis piece, not an official statement.
evidence.step4_criteria_matching: No qualifying events found. The resolution criteria require an EXPLICIT statement from one of four official sources (White House, State Department, Office of the President of Azerbaijan, or MFA of Azerbaijan) that Azerbaijan is in negotiations/talks/discussions or a formal process to join the Abraham Accords. All statements reviewed: (1) [White House Oct 10](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/2025/08/president-trump-brokers-another-historic-peace-deal/) — discusses Armenia-Azerbaijan peace, Abraham Accords mentioned separately as Trump achievements, but Azerbaijan is NOT connected to Abraham Accords in this document. (2) [Rubio Oct 24](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2620099/middle-east) — 'more countries ready to recognize Israel' but does not name Azerbaijan. (3) [Trump Oct 15-17](https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/416414) — predicts Abraham Accords expansion, names Saudi Arabia, not Azerbaijan. (4) [Azerbaijan MFA Oct 10](https://www.trend.az/azerbaijan/politics/4102401.html) — welcomes Gaza ceasefire, no Abraham Accords for Azerbaijan. None of these satisfy the explicit-naming + official-source requirement.
evidence.step5_timestamp_extraction: No qualifying timestamp can be extracted because no qualifying event was found. The closest partial match — the Arutz Sheva/Trump article mentioning 'active U.S. talks with Azerbaijan' — refers to 'reports from months prior' (i.e., before October 2025), and the source is not one of the four qualifying institutions.
evidence.step6_first_occurrence_check: Not applicable — no qualifying occurrence was identified at all during the October 1–31 window.
evidence.step7_verification: Attempted to disprove a No conclusion by searching for: (a) any White House briefing naming Azerbaijan and Abraham Accords together in October 2025; (b) any State Department statement naming Azerbaijan for Abraham Accords; (c) any official Azerbaijani government statement about Abraham Accords membership talks. None found. The evidence consistently shows: Trump and Rubio made general calls for more countries to join without naming Azerbaijan; Azerbaijan's official statements focused on Armenia-Azerbaijan peace normalization and Gaza humanitarian support; third-party experts and analysts identified Azerbaijan as a 'candidate' but this does not meet the resolution criteria. There is no contradictory evidence suggesting a qualifying statement exists.
evidence.step8_final_decision: The question resolves No. Throughout October 2025, there is abundant diplomatic activity involving Azerbaijan (Armenia-Azerbaijan peace accord, White House meetings, Azerbaijan at Sharm el-Sheikh summit, etc.) and general U.S. calls for Abraham Accords expansion — but none of the four designated official sources (White House, State Department, President of Azerbaijan, MFA of Azerbaijan) issued a statement explicitly stating that Azerbaijan is in negotiations or talks to join the Abraham Accords. The window closed on October 31, 2025, with no qualifying event.

question: Will Trump visit Gaza by Dec 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if U.S. President Donald Trump visits the Gaza Strip by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purpose of this market, a "visit" is defined as Trump physically entering the terrestrial territory of the Gaza Strip. Whether or not Trump enters the Gaza Strip's airspace or maritime territory during the timeframe of this market will have no bearing on this market's resolution.

A visit to any area within the terrestrial territory of the Gaza Strip, including visits to buffer zones, counts.

The primary resolution source for this information will be official information from government of the United States of America, or official information from Trump or released by his verified social media accounts (e.g. https://twitter.com/POTUS), however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the White House, U.S. State Department, or Trump announce between 2025-10-14 and 2025-11-13 (inclusive) that Donald Trump is scheduled to travel to or visit Gaza?
subquestions.background_information:
A publicly announced plan for Trump to go to Gaza would be a strong leading indicator for an actual Gaza visit by 2025-12-31, because presidential travel to an active conflict zone is typically preceded by official scheduling, security preparation, and public messaging. Recent reporting suggests this is a live possibility rather than a purely hypothetical scenario. On 2025-10-08, Trump said he might visit Gaza soon while peace negotiations were underway in Egypt and involving U.S., Qatari, Israeli, and Hamas-linked channels, according to TASS and other outlets: https://tass.com/world/1883911 and https://www.lindaikejisblog.com/2025/10/donald-trump-says-he-might-visit-gaza-soon-2.html . There is also precedent for senior U.S. officials reaching Gaza-adjacent or Gaza-located sites during the current crisis: Newsweek reported Trump envoy Steve Witkoff entered northern Gaza on 2025-10-11, accompanied by CENTCOM's Brad Cooper, during implementation of a ceasefire arrangement, suggesting access channels and security coordination may exist for high-level U.S. visits: https://www.newsweek.com/trumps-envoy-enters-gaza-israel-hamas-ceasefire-holds-2101012 . Official presidential travel is normally publicized through White House schedules/statements and often echoed by the State Department or the president's own verified social media accounts; therefore, an official announcement of an intended Gaza stop would be a meaningful near-term crux for whether the ultimate visit happens by year-end.

subquestions.resolution_criteria:
